annotations.title: List the firms with a firm card

description: Lists the consulting firms that win public contracts in Europe and have a firm card (the leading firms of each country), with awards in 24 months, value won, main country and kind of work, and the links to their card and page. Filter by country (firms with awards there), kind, or words of the name. Paged: up to 25 a page, 100 a query.

lang.description: Language of the page links (the data is the same). Default en.
